youtube.baslik: Does only the parent decide on a child's hearing test? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: In Türkiye, under Article 24 of the Patient Rights Regulation, permission is obtained from a parent or guardian if the patient is a minor or under guardianship; the same article provides that a minor patient able to understand should also be heard and take part in the decision. So the test is explained to the child in age-appropriate language and their agreement is sought; this is called the child's assent. Steps such as putting on headphones can first be shown on a toy. This is not legal advice; check the current legislation.
